remarks: Stately 35 Weed Avenue boasts 5 bedrooms and 3 full bathrooms.  West Norwalk position in proximity to Darien and New Canaan. Outdoors, enjoy the expansive deck overlooking the lush and flat landscaped yard, ideal for entertaining or relaxing with in-ground gunite infinity pool.
